name: Team Rocket’s Slowpoke

attacks.name: Scavenge
attacks.text: Put a random Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

flavor:
It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one
knows what it is thinking about. It is good at
fishing with its tail.
